hint_ladder.title: Pansinin ang pattern
hint_ladder.text: Ang sequence na 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13 ay parang Fibonacci. Ang susunod ay sum ng huling dalawang term.

hint_ladder.title: Final answer
hint_ladder.text: Kaya ang susunod na term ay 21. Madali lang, 'di ba?

A.text: You might have chosen A because 13+5=18, but the pattern is sum of two previous terms, not just adding 5.

B.text: You might have chosen B because 13+6=19, guessing an increment, but Fibonacci adds the two preceding numbers.

C.text: You might have chosen C because 13+7=20, missing the two-term sum rule.

D.text: Correct. 21 equals 8+13, following Fibonacci: each term is sum of the previous two.

next_time_rule: If the series starts 1,1,2,3,5,8, it's Fibonacci. Just add the last two terms. No need for complex patterns, i-add lang.
deconstruct_text:
Sa Barangay Masagana, may community pantry na sinundan ang Fibonacci sa weekly budget. Week 1: ₱1,000; Week 2: ₱1,000; Week 3: ₱2,000 (sum ng nakaraang dalawa). Kaya naging 1,1,2,3,5,8,13 (thousands).

Para sa ika-8 linggo, kunin mo ang huling dalawang term: 8 at 13. I-add mo lang: 8+13=21. Kaya ₱21,000 ang budget. Walang komplikado—simple addition lang.

Ang rule: mula ikatlong term, bawat isa ay sum ng dalawang nauna. Kahit umabot ng 100 terms, sisiw basta alam ang pattern.

**Mental Trick:** 'FiBo: First two 1s, then Bo-sum ng dalawa, na-next na sum ulit, chi-check lang last two.'
